metadata.description: Restructured Indian Railways timetable data extracted from PDFs (Delhi-Howrah/Patna corridor focus)
metadata.note: Full raw content was provided in the development session on 2026-05-24. Use the accompanying parse_railway_timetables.py to convert into real-trains.json format for the Java app.

documents.note: Contains ~28+ trains with full station timings for the corridor (15484 Mahananda, 12312 Kalka Howrah, Rajdhani, Poorva, Duronto, Humsafar, etc.). See raw text in session history for complete extraction.
